build_webvid_dataset_builder: build a TensorFlow Dataset builder for WebVid that converts videos to JPEG frames with captions
create_split_mjpeg_stream: create a function that splits a concatenated MJPEG byte stream into individual JPEG images
run_ffmpeg_decode_diskless: run ffmpeg to decode video frames from disk without writing intermediate files to disk
generate_webvid_examples: generate train and validation examples from WebVid CSV captions and MP4 video files
configure_webvid_dataset_info: configure the WebVid dataset schema with video, id, caption, and url features
